migraine is a disease with a genetic predisposition, that migraine is a disorder of brain function and that migraine is a complex disease.
migraine is a disease that is associated with a dysfunction of brain structures that are responsible for the control of pain.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
migraine is a disease of the brain, and not a disease of the blood vessels.
CND method is an effective tool for investigation of migraine mechanisms.
migraine is a disorder of brainstem and limbic system, which is characterized by a complex of functional and morphological alterations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CND method is an important tool for the study of migraine pathogenesis.
migraine is a disorder of cerebral structures activity, which is characterized by the presence of superflous activity in some of them and by a lack of activity in other.

CND method is a useful tool for studying migraine mechanism.
